changelog:
Initial release of the sales-proposal-simulator skill.

- Generates actionable sales proposals and close plans for Meta, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads, Amazon Ads, and Shopify Ads.
- Outputs structured proposals with positioning, deliverables, ROI logic, objection scripts, and close plans.
- Tailors recommendations to each ad platform’s unique requirements and business objectives.
- Includes robust objection handling, rollback/stop-loss conditions, and escalation protocols for high-risk scenarios.
- Offers concrete examples and a detailed quality checklist to ensure proposal clarity and relevance.
